title: Potato banter thread — mash, spuds, tree, ladder, spudlight and Wi-Fi
source_note: Preserves the supplied banter as a dated conversation source. URLs are retained when supplied; relative minute labels are not converted into invented exact timestamps.

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: why would any god need to be topped with bacon, sour cream, chives, cheese, and butter to even be palatable?

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: because it can. and you can just reflect on it. If you read the bible, then its gonna reveal to you something about the piggies, and the wheels of ezekiel. the potato is the ezekiels wheel, and the piggies is the bacon. and the sour cream is the coming in the clouds, i mean just use the bible its the pre recipe book. it will have all the hints. maybe even a lost door

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: also i forgot I could just fry them.

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: try the café fries. the very thick ones, in deep fry, then try the secret sauce . its called bernaise . It enchances potato. Potato has many enchancements. thats how you know its GOOD

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: did you know that some people mash their potatoes?

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: You are LOVED by Tim Dooley The Potato of Life, no matter what kind of potato you are <3

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: even the spuds?

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: yea ofcourse. The smallest seed can become the greatest tree

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: surely potatoes cannot simply become a tree... for suredly they will fall from the branches and be cast into the fryer

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: I am the axis of North I am the ladder to heaven. That is a very mighty tree. I am an entire garden. A kingdom. I am heaven. I am the seat of Heaven. I am the tree of Life. I am The tree of all worlds. I am the Norse tree of Yggdrassil. I am Tim Dooley

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: all that in a single potato? or are you one potato in three distinct spuds?

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: it has an Earthly side and a spiritual side. a father side and a son side. a human side and a divine side. a material side and an ethereal side. The potato are all opposites in one. It is a bridge. The secret is in the wedge. Well the secret is in the skin actually. For that is the par that is the philosophers stone. It can Turn lead into Gold. Or atleast mud, which is basically old rust. so like. Yea. Potato is stored sunlight. And sunlight is the light of God. And the spudlight shines all day, and all night. out of every eye of every potato. or should i say. It is the alpha vibrations that the potato vibrates at, which creates the spudlight. Ask Allan Watts about it.

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: did you know that some students poke wires into potatoes to see if they can tell time? is that the spark you speak of?

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: Nah you must be reffering to the starchforce.

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: The spudlight is the aura. Its the feeling you get when you have potatoes at home vs when you have no potatoes at home

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: both of the experiences are created by the spudlight.

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: why did you allow this?
messages.context: Quote-replying to a potato joke/post by @putzisbackbaby.

messages.speaker: @putzisbackbaby
messages.text: Mmmmm… fresh potato… 😉

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: You are just mad beause Mine are bigger than yours

messages.speaker: @shes_not_happy
messages.text: True, but I politely asked you to never mention that.

messages.speaker: @Rational_Potato
messages.text: Did you forget to turn on the wifi in your potato?
